proposed_widenings.name: Range.emanation
proposed_widenings.justification: The spell's area is a 10-foot Emanation centered on and moving with the caster. This is mechanically distinct from `self` (no area), `touch` (single-target), and `point` (fixed location). Emanations travel with the caster throughout the spell's duration.
proposed_widenings.evidence: "nature spirits that flit around you in a 10-foot Emanation for the duration"

proposed_widenings.name: ongoing_emanation
proposed_widenings.justification: The spell plants a moving area on the caster that fires optional save-gated damage on three distinct movement triggers (caster moves into creature, creature enters area, creature ends turn in area). No existing family models this pattern. `ongoing_effect` only handles `roll_modifier` and `damage_on_hit` operations bound to a static attachment. This spell requires: (a) a self-moving area attachment, (b) movement-event triggers that open save windows, (c) optionality on the caster's part, (d) once-per-turn-per-creature rate limiting.
proposed_widenings.evidence: "Whenever the Emanation enters the space of a creature you can see and whenever a creature you can see enters the Emanation or ends its turn there, you can force that creature to make a Wisdom saving throw."

proposed_widenings.name: creature_movement_window (or: emanation_contact_window)
proposed_widenings.justification: The triggers — creature enters area, area enters creature's space, creature ends turn in area — are movement-event windows distinct from any existing window atom. `on_hit_window`, `post_action_window`, `reaction_window`, `rest_window` do not cover creature-movement-into-area events. A new window atom is needed for emanation contact/entry and end-of-turn-in-area.
proposed_widenings.evidence: "Whenever the Emanation enters the space of a creature … or ends its turn there"

proposed_widenings.name: per_creature_per_turn_fence
proposed_widenings.justification: "A creature makes this save only once per turn" requires a per-creature-per-turn rate limiter that resets on the creature's next turn. The existing `use_count` atom resets on rest or turn start (wielder's turn). This is a per-target-per-turn gate not representable with current atoms.
proposed_widenings.evidence: "A creature makes this save only once per turn."

proposed_widenings.name: grant_action_as_bonus_action (or: modify_action_cost)
proposed_widenings.justification: The secondary effect allows the caster to take Disengage as a Bonus Action for the spell's duration. No current spell Effect variant covers granting an action-type substitution. `grant_extra_action` is a class-feature atom and grants a full additional action, not a cost reduction to Bonus Action.
proposed_widenings.evidence: "you can take the Disengage action as a Bonus Action for the spell's duration"

proposed_widenings.name: ActivationPhase.optional_save_gate (or: caster-optional flag on save_gate)
proposed_widenings.justification: The caster explicitly CHOOSES whether to invoke the save ('you can force'). The existing `save_gate` ActivationPhase and SaveGateRider both fire unconditionally on their trigger. A caster-optional flag or a new optional save-gate variant is needed.
proposed_widenings.evidence: "you can force that creature to make a Wisdom saving throw"

notes: The spell's core pattern — moving self-emanation + caster-optional movement-triggered save gates + per-target-per-turn rate limiting + secondary action-cost grant — does not fit any of the four existing spell families. `ongoing_effect` is the closest but handles static attachments with always-on riders, not caster-moving areas with optional event-triggered saves. A new `ongoing_emanation` (or similar) family is needed. The damage scaling itself (5d8 base, +1d8/slot above 4) is representable as `linear_per_level` on `slot` axis, but that is the only component that fits cleanly. No `.dhall` or `.json` authored: forcing this into `ongoing_effect` would produce a false trace.
